title: Day Counter 🌞✅
description: A simple day counter display above your hotbar that will tell you the current world day, useful for Hardcore world and 100 days challenges
body:
![Shows the text "Day 897" above the hotbar in Minecraft, indicating the player has survived 897 days](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4aba378696b57750df7fb856ac4c4c948c1e78bf.png)

Permanently adds the current world day _(visible in the F3 menu)_ above your hotbar for better view.

You can **safely add this datapack to already created worlds** by dropping the zip file in the datapack folder of said world.
